name: agents
description: Agent orchestration: orchestrate (run a spec'd feature or task list with role-separated agents, a strong model to think, plan and review and a fast model to build, routed by task for token-efficient use; agent-agnostic with Claude as the default) and parallel (several features or tracks at once, each on its own branch in a worktree, landed on dev one at a time)

tokenStatus.title: Token status
tokenStatus.description: A status line with the cards in flight (projected / used) and what the budget leaves, a toast when the wave stops fitting or a card passes its projection, and /tokens; read from .ai-gent/orchestrate-status.md and token_report.py budget

tokenRefreshSeconds.title: Token status refresh (seconds)
tokenRefreshSeconds.description: How often, after a turn, the budget is read again (it reads a week of transcripts)

tokenBurnRate.title: Token burn rate and ETA
tokenBurnRate.description: After each cap in the token status, how long what it leaves lasts at the current account-wide pace (session left 3.10M (~2h10m)); the script computes it, the window is rate_window_minutes in .ai-gent/budget.yaml

tokenEtaWarnMinutes.title: Token ETA warning (minutes)
tokenEtaWarnMinutes.description: A toast when a cap would run out within this many minutes at the current pace, once per crossing; 0 turns the toast off and keeps the status

cardCostToast.title: Card cost on landing
cardCostToast.description: A toast when a card lands with what it cost against what was projected (004-us1-core landed: used 391k vs ~420k projected (-7%)), and one when the wave's last card lands; read from the Tokens column of .ai-gent/orchestrate-status.md. Needs the token status on

cardCostHintPercent.title: Landing toast hint (percent)
cardCostHintPercent.description: A miss of at least this many percent, over or under, adds a pointer to what to fix; 0 turns the hint off

cardsPane.title: Card timeline pane
cardsPane.description: /cards-pane opens a pane with the orchestrated cards (state, branch, tokens), the state changes seen while it is open and, on Measure, each card's span with the peak parallelism; it never opens by itself and does not depend on the token status

cardsPollSeconds.title: Card pane poll (seconds)
cardsPollSeconds.description: How often the open pane checks whether the ledger changed (one stat; nothing else runs)

worktreeBoard.title: Worktree board
worktreeBoard.description: /worktree-board opens a pane with one row per .worktrees/<branch> (ahead and behind the dev branch, uncommitted changes and, when gh is signed in and origin is on GitHub, the pull request and its checks); read-only, it never opens by itself and does not depend on the token status

worktreeBoardSeconds.title: Worktree board refresh (seconds)
worktreeBoardSeconds.description: How often the open board runs wt.py list --json again (a Bash call that runs wt.py, git commit or git merge refreshes it at once)

worktreeBoardRemoteSeconds.title: Worktree board pull request refresh (seconds)
worktreeBoardRemoteSeconds.description: How often the open board runs one gh pr list for the pull requests and their checks
